subject: Zone-level stockouts
body:
Hi Priya,

Your team's September post on the Lumen blog said stockouts in new zones still run at 9% because demand is forecast per city. I hit the same wall at Fernleaf Grocers.

I rebuilt our demand forecast at store-zone level, and stockouts in new zones fell from 11% to 6% in one quarter. Lumen's Senior Data Analyst opening covers that same forecasting work.

Would a 15 minute call next week be useful? If someone else owns this hire, a name is plenty.

Thanks,
